headline.caveat: Price undisclosed. 25-year PPA for the 615MW Duane Arnold Energy Center (IA) restart; plant shut in 2020, restart targeted early 2029.

realized_to_date.caveat: No power until the restart (targeted early 2029); no PPA cash has flowed.

nature_md: Google agreed to a 25-year PPA for the output of NextEra's Duane Arnold nuclear plant in Iowa — a 615MW BWR shut down in 2020 after derecho damage — which NextEra will restart, targeting early 2029, to serve Google's Iowa data-center load and broader MISO demand. The contracted offtake is what makes the restart financeable; NextEra funds the restart work itself. The third US nuclear restart underwritten by a hyperscaler (after TMI/Microsoft and Palisades).

accounting.payer_treatment_md: Alphabet books nothing until COD (~2029), then power as data-center opex; ~25-year commitment disclosed as an unrecorded purchase obligation.
accounting.payee_treatment_md: NextEra capitalizes restart costs and recognizes revenue from commercial operation; the PPA converts a retired asset back into a contracted rate-of-return-like cash flow. No disclosed Google prepayment or restart funding.
